payload.text: Every message names how the dispatcher is invoked, ${DEVBIN_INVOKE:-bin/devbin}, as every other built-in does, never the project's name or the literal devbin. The project's name named a command only while each estate had a launcher of that name; those launchers are retired, so a message carrying it tells the reader to type a command that does not exist (issue 0107, hv's ruling K8).
